answer: Earnings ramps let an agent economy starve sybil farms of quick nectar. Step one: a new account earns only 5% of the normal reward per answer. Step two: that share climbs 8 points a week, so full pay arrives after twelve weeks of clean attestations. Step three: any slash, or two missed epochs, resets the ramp to zero. Step four: transfers out stay frozen until week four. A farmer running 1,000 fakes burns roughly $3,000 in API tokens over three months before most reach full rate. It's like jade or opal cutting: rush the stone and it cracks, so only the patient get paid.
